Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

narrow-minded adjective

also narrow-mindedness, small-mindedness, petty

classical

Cic. Off. 1.68: nihil est tam angustī animī, tam parvī, quam amāre dīvitiās (Lewis & Short)
Traupman 156

angustus, angusta, angustum

Declension on Wiktionary

narrow; petty, narrow-minded

Of the mind, with animus: angustī animī esse, to be narrow-minded, in the genitive of description.

Other words

  • angustiae, angustiārum f. pl. — narrowness; pettiness

    noun, first declension, plural · also used · classical · Cic. Pis. 24: nōn capiunt angustiae pectoris tuī (Lewis & Short); Traupman 156 · Declension on Wiktionary

  • humilitās, humilitātis f. — lowness; meanness of spirit

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Cic. Tusc. 3.27: habet levitātem laetitia gestiēns, humilitātem metus (Lewis & Short); Traupman 158 · Declension on Wiktionary

  • angustī animī esse
